title: Two days on Con Dao
budget: Check on arrival. The scenic fee does not include the relic ticket or the boat.
pace: One history day, then the park
summary: Day one is the camps and Hàng Dương, on foot in town. Day two is the park: Đầm Trầu in the text, and the boat toward the turtle islets. On-site minutes for the prison were not printed. The scenic fee is not the relic ticket.

days.title: Day 1 — The camps and Hàng Dương
days.body: Walk the prison as one site, then the cemetery. The history museum counts nearly 2,000 fighters held. The ministry article counts about 20,000 dead. Both stay. The indexed gate hours did not load, so they are check on arrival. The night market on Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng starts at 17:00.

days.title: Day 2 — The park and the islets
days.body: The park day is the forest and the water. Đầm Trầu is the swim the Vietnamese page calls yellow sand and the English page calls amber. No licensed frame of that beach is on this page. Hòn Bảy Cạnh is about 45 minutes by boat. Time ashore and the fare are check on arrival.
